findings.title: Start the warm impact call from the prior impact record, not diagnostic queries
findings.mechanism: After the separate get_ground_impact_point call and record observation, two extra point_above_ground checks run on corrected pb/qb before the call labelled warm. Their ordinary elevation clauses can change the shared record. Thus warm_same/warm_different compares a different instrumented query sequence, rather than the immediate repeat on the record the first impact left. The original function already evaluates its own ASSERT expressions; those must remain intact.
findings.bounded_correction: Save the exact separate-call post-record and restore it before warm, or perform the diagnostic predicate checks after the warm observation. Keep their results separately identified. Add a focused collaborator/observation check that detects an intervening record mutation before warm without mirroring the original solver.

findings.title: Require restoration/hash measurements rather than only report row names
findings.mechanism: ground-record restored=1 with both words_before and words_after absent passes because nil equals nil. A bare ground-hash row also passes. Required family rows need only exist, so missing or inconsistent counter values are accepted. Identical repeats of such a malformed report can reach a successful state_digest although no usable restoration/hash evidence was supplied. The current stand-in tests do not reject these cases.
findings.bounded_correction: Validate mandatory result schema: one required row per family, anchored/restored flags, exact hash/record-word strings, numeric finite/integer counters and correspondence to requested point/impact counts. Reject missing/duplicate fields/rows and inconsistent cardinalities before calling the report a result. Add real-driver negative controls for missing record words, missing hash fields and inconsistent counts; keep valid zero-count families supported.

findings.title: Qualify which original folds remain comparable after G1/G2 composition
findings.mechanism: The proposed later candidate comparison names ground-hash/counters/samples generally. These folds include legacy sector/triangle fields and pointer-presence-derived held bits, and the original-only fixture directly accesses those legacy members. G1 replaces that layout with semantic values/optional hints. Those diagnostics are not interchangeable physical answers and must not become a generic/DCS provider requirement.
findings.bounded_correction: Preserve the original oracle and explicitly classify physical input/output, macro short-circuit facts and original-private record diagnostics. Require a deliberate fixture adaptation and documented comparison scope when composing G1/G2; do not force legacy indices/pointers into public host contracts or silently rewrite the old folds.
